Provides generic utility functions for common slice and map operations.

## Key Components

- **`Unique[T comparable]`** — Returns a deduplicated slice of any comparable type by converting elements to map keys and collecting them back into a slice.

## Usage Example

```go
nums := []int{1, 2, 2, 3, 3, 3}
result := util.Unique(nums)
// result: [1, 2, 3] (order not guaranteed)

strs := []string{"a", "b", "a", "c"}
result := util.Unique(strs)
// result: ["a", "b", "c"] (order not guaranteed)
```

> **Note:** Since the deduplication relies on map key iteration, the order of elements in the returned slice is **not guaranteed**.
